p: Beckham has been released and is no longer part of the Giants' receiver rotation.
The WR4 role he was hoped to fill is gone, which opens the door for other receivers to get snaps and targets.
It just wasn't the best thing for our offense.
Beckham could see more work in the offensive plan this Sunday.
If he gets more involved right away, he becomes a possible WR flex option, but the name is garbled in the captions and Harbaugh only said he hopes it happens.
I would think Sunday would be great.
